page_title: VIL 2-2 ATM | Villarreal v Atletico Madrid 19/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Guillermo Cuadra is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Diego Simeone is stunned as referee Guillermo Cuadra shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
90+4' Handball by Pape Gueye (Villarreal).
90+2' The game is interrupted as Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) is flagged offside.
90+2' Substitution. Dani Parejo walks off the pitch and Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) comes on as a substitute.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
86' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for holding. Guillermo Cuadra signals a set piece.
85' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
84' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
83' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His rocket of a shot crashes against the crossbar! What a shot.
82' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) will take the free kick.
81' Guillermo Cuadra shows the yellow card to Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) for a heavy challenge.
79' Ruben Uria has decided to substitute Arnaut Danjuma and he is replaced by Ayoze Perez (Villarreal).
78' Substitution. Antoine Griezmann makes way for Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid).
77' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
76' The corner from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is cleared away by the defence.

76' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
74' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
72' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Arnaut Danjuma (Villarreal) heads on.
71' Yeremy Pino goes off the pitch and Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) comes on.
71' That will be all from Alex Baena who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Pape Gueye (Villarreal).
71' Marcelino prepares a substitution. Gerard Moreno is replaced by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal).
71' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) sends a long ball forward to Antoine Griezmann, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
67' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:5.
64' We are about to witness a substitution. Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) is replacing Koke.
62' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
61' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.

61' A huge rebound finds Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) unmarked on the edge of the box. He lines up a shot but slips just before he hits it and sends the ball miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
61' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
61' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
60' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Atl. Madrid earn a corner.
58' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
58' Alex Baena (Villarreal) prepares to take a corner kick.
57' Arnaut Danjuma (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Villarreal force their opponents to concede a corner.
57' Alex Baena (Villarreal) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just wide of the left post.
56' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Guillermo Cuadra signals. Villarreal win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
54' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) replacing Reinildo Mandava.
53' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
53' Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Diego Conde comes off his line to gather the ball.
51' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle after Alex Baena (Villarreal) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
49' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
49' The attendance is 21566.
46' The game is over for Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid). Angel Correa comes on for the second half.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) comes off for Jose Maria Gimenez.
46' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+5' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) makes it 2:2. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Pablo Barrios and planted his close-range header low into the middle of the goal. Diego Conde was helpless.
45+3' Referee Guillermo Cuadra sees the trip by Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
45+2' Arnaut Danjuma (Villarreal) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.

45+1' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom right corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Jan Oblak, who tips the ball around the post.
45+1' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Guillermo Cuadra didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
42' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper.
40' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) for a tough tackle.
38' 2 - 1 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Koke (Atl. Madrid), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 2:1.
37' Alex Baena (Villarreal) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

36' Arnaut Danjuma (Villarreal) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Villarreal.
36' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies onto the right post!
31' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
30' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) makes a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Koke (Atl. Madrid) brings his opponent down. Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
25' Flag up against Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
24' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
20' 1 - 1 Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) has a great chance inside the box and slams the ball into the top right corner.

19' 1 - 0 Arnaut Danjuma (Villarreal) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Jan Oblak is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
17' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
16' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Diego Jose Conde Alcoado intercepts the ball.
14' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) takes a short corner kick.

13' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Diego Jose Conde Alcoado produces a wonderful reflex save. The referee signals a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.
13' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
10' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) picks up a caution.
9' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and signals a foul after Raul Albiol (Villarreal) brought his opponent down.
9' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) sends a long ball forward to Santi Comesana, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
6' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
5' Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
2' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

Villarreal will kick the game off.
